mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in labor demand (PAYEMS) signals stronger employment growth, boosting corporate profits and equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in labor expansion periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or labor demand shows no sustained upward trend.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in the federal funds rate and rise in demand (GDPC1) create a dual easing environment that amplifies positive equity returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Interaction effect between FEDFUNDS and GDPC1 is not statistically significant (p > 0.05) or returns do not follow expected direction despite the signal.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward crossing of the CPIAUCSL index above 200 signals rising inflation expectations, prompting preemptive rate hikes that compress equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in inflationary periods are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or CPIAUCSL does not cross the 200 threshold.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, a sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals stronger accommodative policy, which disproportionately boosts equity returns over the next 20 trading days compared to other regimes.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS decline does not lead to significantly higher returns than baseline in late-cycle periods (t-test p > 0.05) or regime conditions are not met.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in supply (INDPRO) and decline in unemployment (UNRATE) indicates robust economic capacity and labor market health, fostering confidence and equity returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Interaction effect between INDPRO and UNRATE is not statistically significant (p > 0.05) or returns do not follow expected direction despite the signal.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward crossing of HOUST above 2000 units signals heightened housing demand, driving consumer spending and corporate profits, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in housing demand periods are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) or HOUST does not cross the 2000 threshold.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in supply (INDPRO) reflects stronger production capacity and lower inflationary pressures, enhancing equity valuations and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in supply expansion periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or INDPRO shows no sustained upward trend.
